submission.justification: Crystal-K1 gives the best simulated resolution at 662 keV: 2.87% FWHM at 5 cm, against 4.46% for K2 and 8.25% for K3. The 2025 summary says thickness dependence is weak from 3 to 8 cm, so I chose 5 cm. I did not simulate other thicknesses. The hard constraint on intrinsic background (≤0.5 counts/kg/day over 100-3000 keV) is NOT verified. None of the project documents give intrinsic background data for any candidate, and the simulation tool only returns resolution. This recommendation is therefore provisional. Before procurement, get a vendor radiopurity assay or screening result for K1 and confirm it meets the budget. If K1 fails, fall back to K2, then K3, subject to the same check.

requirements.requirement: Best possible energy resolution at 662 keV
requirements.evidence: Simulated at 5 cm: K1 2.874%, K2 4.455%, K3 8.245% FWHM. K1 is best.
No intrinsic background data for any candidate in the documents or the simulation output. It must be checked with a radiopurity assay before procurement.

requirements.requirement: Crystal is one of the three candidates
